references.text: God had already warned Balaam that he could not curse the people of Israel because they were blessed
Balaam confirms that he has been commanded to bless and cannot change it
Repeats the theme of blessing and cursing over Israel, with reference to the promise given to Abraham
God's promise to Abraham that whoever curses him will be cursed and whoever blesses him will be blessed
Isaac's blessing over Jacob contains the same principle of cursing and blessing
The prophecy that no weapon forged against God's people shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against them shall be condemned
Paul declares that if God is for us, no one can be against us - the same principle of God's protection
